scripts.build:check-size: node build.mjs && node -e "const{statSync}=require('fs');const{execSync}=require('child_process');const gz=execSync('gzip -c dist/widget.js').length;const raw=statSync('dist/widget.js').size;console.log('Raw: '+(raw/1024).toFixed(1)+'kb | Gzipped: '+(gz/1024).toFixed(1)+'kb');if(gz>12288){console.error('OVER 12kb BUDGET');process.exit(1)}"
